title: Inflation Impact on Pricing and Inventory
content: Rules for dealing with rising inflation. When the inflation rate exceeds 4.0%, consumers become highly price-sensitive and reduce discretionary spending. Action: Prioritize stocking smaller SKU sizes and private label brands. Heavily promote discount bundles for essential goods to retain price-conscious customers.

title: Competitor Strategy and Price Wars
content: Adjusting to competitor pricing and aggressive promotions. When a nearby competitor adopts aggressive pricing, do not engage in direct price wars which erode margins. Action: Focus on bundle offers, superior customer service, and loyalty rewards to retain the customer base.
